feedback.title: How did the meetup go?
feedback.privacy: Only our team sees your answer – {name} never will. It helps us keep this a place for people who respect boundaries.
feedback.privacyNoName: Only our team sees your answer – the other person never will. It helps us keep this a place for people who respect boundaries.
feedback.preserve: Keep the record of the meetup in case you need to go to the police. Otherwise the agreement is deleted after 48 hours.
feedback.suspendNotice: If someone didn't respect you or you're in danger, we'll suspend their account right away and look into it.
feedback.helpIntro: We'll look into it, and we've suspended the other person's account while we review it. You don't have to decide right now what to do next – and none of this is your fault.

feedback.medical: If something happened against your will, get medical help as soon as you can – also to prevent pregnancy and infections, as some medication only works within 72 hours. Evidence can still be collected if you haven't showered yet and you keep your clothes. But none of this is a requirement – you can report it later, too.
feedback.preserved: We've kept the record of the meetup (agreement, messages, alarms) in case you need it for the police.

safetySettings.appLockHint: Face ID, fingerprint or your phone's passcode every time you open the app.
safetySettings.discreetHint: A neutral icon and notifications without content – nobody can tell what app it is.
